_comment: PARTIAL / PROVISIONAL. Core API, extensions, features, and portability subset flags updated from real Apple M3 + MoltenVK 1.2.6 startup log (Vulkan 1.2.261, VK_KHR_portability_subset, VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering, VK_EXT_memory_budget, triangleFans=true, no logicOp / wideLines / geometryShader / shaderFloat64). Rebuild from a full Mac vulkaninfo dump before relying on exact limits or format support. SIMULATE_FORMATS_BIT is intentionally NOT enabled in tools/run-apple-profile.ps1 because this file omits a complete VkFormat feature table. Note: khronos_profiles.emulate_portability requires Vulkan SDK < 1.4.363; on 1.4.363+ the profile still simulates API 1.2.261 and missing logicOp/wideLines/geometryShader/shaderFloat64.

VP_VOOLKAN_APPLE_M.label: voolkan Apple Silicon / MoltenVK (M3 log-calibrated)
VP_VOOLKAN_APPLE_M.description: Apple Silicon + MoltenVK 1.2.6 profile (calibrated from Apple M3 startup log): Vulkan 1.2.261, portability subset, dynamic rendering, memory budget, no logicOp / wideLines / geometryShader / shaderFloat64.
